categories.prompt: Name a named dish cooked or wrapped in plant leaves.

categories.prompt: Name a corn-based food or drink.
categories.scope: Corn or cornmeal must be a defining ingredient. Foods, drinks and edible corn products count; incidental corn-derived additives do not make every food corn-based.

categories.prompt: Name a named pasta or noodle dish.
categories.scope: Named dishes and established menu preparations count, including familiar meal names such as spaghetti, udon and soba, filled pastas and gnocchi. A bare unfilled pasta-shape name without a dish or established menu preparation does not count. Plain tteokbokki is a rice-cake dish; rabokki includes noodles.

categories.prompt: Name a type of custard or a dessert made with custard.

categories.prompt: Name an object designed to be inflated.

categories.prompt: Name a tool or piece of equipment used for gardening.

categories.prompt: Name an item or product used to wash, dry or care for laundry.

categories.prompt: Name an object that commonly has a hinge.

categories.prompt: Name a hand tool or utensil used to prepare or serve food.
categories.scope: Kitchen hand tools, utensils, serving implements and nonpowered cookware count. Small measuring tools used in food preparation also count. Large powered appliances and foods do not qualify.

categories.prompt: Name a block an Enderman can pick up in Minecraft.
categories.scope: The actual block-pickup rule counts, including flowers. Endermen may pick up only certain blocks even if the player can carry other blocks. Official Java 26.3 recipe, tag or component data defines the inventory; modded behavior does not count.

categories.prompt: Name a flower or flowering block found in Minecraft.
categories.scope: Flower items and blocks count, including tall flowers and Nether-compatible flowers. Named crops and saplings do not become flowers merely because they are plants. Official Java 26.3 recipe, tag or component data defines the inventory; modded behavior does not count.

categories.prompt: Name an item you can catch by fishing in Minecraft.
categories.scope: Fish, junk and treasure in the ordinary fishing loot tables count. Items merely carried by nearby mobs do not. Official Java 26.3 recipe, tag or component data defines the inventory; modded behavior does not count.

categories.prompt: Name an item that can be used as furnace fuel in Minecraft.
categories.scope: Items actually accepted in the fuel slot count, rather than anything that merely looks flammable. Their fuel value need not be the same. Official Java 26.3 recipe, tag or component data defines the inventory; modded behavior does not count.

categories.prompt: Name an exercise that can be done using your bodyweight instead of added weights.

categories.prompt: Name a player who has won the NBA regular-season MVP award.
categories.scope: Winners of the main NBA regular-season Most Valuable Player award through the 2025–26 season count. Finals, All-Star and other leagues' MVP awards are different.

categories.prompt: Name a quarterback who started and won a Super Bowl.
categories.scope: The quarterback must have started a winning Super Bowl, through Super Bowl LX in February 2026. Winning a ring as a backup alone does not count.

categories.prompt: Name a real animal that has horns or antlers.
categories.scope: Living and extinct animals count, including beetle horns and other actual horn-like structures. Feathers that merely look like horns do not count. A named animal group counts when it contains horned or antlered members.

categories.prompt: Name an animal that can produce its own light.
categories.scope: Bioluminescence, including light produced by symbiotic bacteria in an animal's light organ, counts. Reflection, fluorescence and bright coloring alone do not. Broad animal groups count when they contain documented luminous members.

categories.prompt: Name an animal that makes a regular seasonal migration.
categories.scope: Named species and animal groups with documented recurring seasonal, breeding or feeding migrations count, including migrating populations of a species. One-off escapes or an individual simply wandering do not.

categories.prompt: Name a food crop with an edible part that normally grows underground.
categories.scope: Roots, tubers, rhizomes, bulbs, corms and underground fruits count. Named crop kinds and established edible varieties count. A normal above-ground fruit does not count merely because the plant has roots.

categories.prompt: Name a bone or named group of bones in the human skeleton.
categories.scope: Standard named bones, fused bones and familiar bone groups count. Left and right instances are the same answer. Cartilage, joints, muscles and organs are not bones.

categories.prompt: Name a unit used to measure a physical quantity or digital information.
categories.scope: Established metric, customary, historical and scientific measurement units count, including named prefixed units. Currency units and arbitrary made-up units do not. Official unit symbols are accepted only when they name that actual unit.

categories.prompt: Name a structure or component found in a living cell.
categories.scope: Plant, animal, fungal and prokaryotic cell structures count. Whole organs or tissues are not structures inside one cell. Established molecular structures such as DNA and chromosomes count. Cellular structures and molecular assemblies count; an individual pigment such as chlorophyll is not an organelle or cell structure by itself.

categories.prompt: Name one of the 88 official constellations.
categories.scope: Official IAU constellation names count. Recognized common names such as Capricorn and the Great Bear are accepted. Asterisms such as the Big Dipper are only parts of constellations.

categories.prompt: Name a playable hero in Dota 2.
categories.scope: The complete official playable hero roster in the October 25, 2026 snapshot counts. Items, cosmetics and non-playable creeps are not heroes.

categories.prompt: Name a playable hero in Overwatch.
categories.scope: The full official Overwatch roster in the October 25, 2026 snapshot counts, including heroes introduced while it was called Overwatch 2. Skins and unplayable story characters do not.

categories.prompt: Name a playable fighter in Super Smash Bros. Ultimate.
categories.scope: All base-game, Echo and DLC fighters count. Pokémon Trainer's three Pokémon, the three Mii fighting styles, and Pyra/Mythra count separately. Alternate costumes share the original fighter's answer; Assist Trophies do not count.

categories.prompt: Name a Legendary or Mythical Pokémon.

categories.prompt: Name a character from the Harry Potter books or films.

categories.prompt: Name a music act known as a duo.

categories.prompt: Name a real mountain range.
categories.scope: Named ranges, chains, mountain systems and subranges count, anywhere in the world. A single peak by itself is not a range.

categories.prompt: Name a real museum.

categories.prompt: Name a type of cookie or biscuit, including named branded varieties.

categories.prompt: Name a pie, tart or flan.
categories.scope: Named sweet and savory pies, tarts and flans count. An ordinary cake without a conventional pie name, pizza or an uncrusted omelette does not qualify.

categories.scope: Named breakfast-cereal kinds, brands and products count, including hot cereals, muesli, granola and historical products. An unrelated food does not count just because its maker also sells cereal.

categories.prompt: Name a food or drink made using fermentation.

categories.prompt: Name a salad dressing.

categories.prompt: Name a recognized pizza style or named pizza variety.
